name: Idre

seo.title: Idre Fjäll ski resort guide
seo.description: Sweden's southernmost mountain, with 41 slopes facing every direction, almost all accommodation ski-in ski-out, and a snow guarantee from 19 December.
seo.twitterDescription: 41 slopes in every direction, ski-in ski-out, snow guarantee from 19 December.
seo.webpageDescription: Ski facts, season dates, where to stay and how to get to Idre Fjäll in Dalarna, Sweden.

h1: Idre Fjäll ski resort, stays & events guide
heroText: Idre Fjäll is Sweden's southernmost mountain, and its 41 slopes face in every direction, so there is usually shelter whichever way the wind blows. Almost all the accommodation is ski-in ski-out with the shops and restaurants on foot, and the 2026/27 season runs from 19 December to 4 April under a snow guarantee.
stayOverview: Idre Fjäll is one resort with fourteen named cabin areas rather than several villages. Almost all of them are ski-in ski-out, so the question is how far you want to walk to the grocery store and the restaurants, not how far to the lift.
hotelIntro: Book against the season window: the snow guarantee runs 19 December 2026 to 4 April 2027 and lets you cancel up to three days before arrival if fewer than 10 slopes are open.
rentalCars: Almost everything on the mountain is within walking distance, so a car is mainly for getting here. Idre village is down in the valley.

travelTips.title: Snow guarantee
travelTips.text: At least 10 slopes and 2.5 km of cross-country track open, or you can cancel up to three days before arrival and get your money back.

travelTips.title: Season window
travelTips.text: The 2026/27 guarantee runs 19 December 2026 to 4 April 2027.

travelTips.title: Whichever way the wind blows
travelTips.text: The slopes face in every direction, so there is usually a sheltered side.

travelTips.title: Early cross-country
travelTips.text: Up to 5 km of groomed track opens from 23 October.

highlights.title: Slopes in every direction
highlights.text: 41 slopes laid out all round the mountain, so weather and snow conditions can be chosen rather than endured.

highlights.title: Ski-in ski-out
highlights.text: Almost all accommodation on the mountain reaches the slopes directly, with shops and restaurants within walking distance.

highlights.title: The snow guarantee
highlights.text: Idre Fjäll guarantees 10 open slopes and 2.5 km of track between 19 December and 4 April, or your money back.

highlights.title: Race Arena
highlights.text: A dedicated competition arena on the mountain, used for training camps and the Craft Idre Fjällmaraton.

highlights.title: Barnens Vasalopp
highlights.text: A children's cross-country race for under-12s every Wednesday at 14:00, with a diploma and blueberry soup for everyone who finishes.
